mediastore.DB: Database component: actual database storing user data, password hashes, and audio-file metadata; ordinary “db” means database.
mediastore.Facade: Server-side web front end delivering websites, registration/login pages, session management, and browse/download/upload access.
mediastore.FileStorage: DataStorage/FileStorage: separate file location storing uploaded audio files and serving retrieval; ordinary “storage” means keeping files.
mediastore.MediaAccess: Stores uploaded audio at a predefined location and encapsulates audio metadata database access and listing/fetching.
mediastore.Packaging: Archives multiple audio files into one compressed file for multi-file downloads; ordinary “packaging” means packing items together.
mediastore.Reencoding: ReEncoder/Reencoding component converts audio bit rates before watermarking, often reducing file size; ordinary “reencoding” means encoding again.
mediastore.TagWatermarking: Digitally and individually watermarks re-encoded downloaded audio files to link each file to a user.

teastore.ImageProvider: Service delivering WebUI images as base64, matching product/UI names and sizes, with cache and scaling.
teastore.OrderBasedRecommender: Recommender variant using an order-based nearest-neighbor approach; recommendation time depends on cart items and stored orders.
teastore.Persistence: Service providing relational-database access, mapping entities to JSON, and exposing CRUD endpoints with caching.
teastore.Registry: Single service registry tracking online service instances and locations via startup registration and periodic heartbeats; ordinary registry means a register list.
teastore.SlopeOneRecommender: Known-user recommender variant applying Slope One item-based collaborative filtering to calculate recommendations.
teastore.WebUI: Frontend service using Servlets and JSPs, handling cookies, status page, and retrieving images from Image Provider.

teammates.Client: Administrative scripts connecting directly to the back end; “client” ordinarily means a user program.
teammates.Common: Shared utilities, exceptions, and data-transfer objects used across the application; “common” ordinarily means shared.
teammates.E2E: End-to-end testing component interacting with the whole application via browsers or REST API calls.
teammates.GAE Datastore: Google App Engine NoSQL datastore persistence framework used by Storage for application data operations.
teammates.Logic: Business-logic component managing relationships, transactions, sanitization, access control, and API integrations.
teammates.Storage: CRUD-focused data layer hiding datastore complexity and persistable entities behind storage APIs.
teammates.Test Driver: Testing infrastructure and helpers automating regression tests across components and system actions.
teammates.UI: Angular-generated single-page web front end handling most requests and browser interactions; “UI” means user interface.

bigbluebutton.Apps: Main real-time collaboration application providing users, chat, whiteboard, and presentations; “apps” ordinarily means software programs.
bigbluebutton.BBB web: Java/Scala web application implementing the BigBlueButton API and holding a copy of meeting state.
bigbluebutton.FSESL: Separate application integrating with FreeSWITCH via its Event Socket Layer using Redis PubSub messages.
bigbluebutton.FreeSWITCH: Audio-handling software providing voice conferencing, WebRTC audio, and phone/VoIP call-in capability.
bigbluebutton.HTML5 Client: Single-page responsive web application for the user interface and WebRTC audio/video connections.
bigbluebutton.HTML5 Server: Meteor.js server behind nginx, communicating with clients and keeping client state consistent via MongoDB.
bigbluebutton.Presentation Conversion: Process converting uploaded presentations, including Office files to PDF and PDF to SVG, for client display.
bigbluebutton.Recording Service: Recording processor that, after meetings end, processes stored Redis events and raw media files.
bigbluebutton.Redis DB: Redis database storing all meeting events when a meeting is recorded; “DB” means database.
bigbluebutton.Redis PubSub: Redis publish/subscribe channel for communication between BigBlueButton applications and for conversion progress messages.
bigbluebutton.WebRTC-SFU: Media controller handling negotiations and managing media streams; “SFU” means selective forwarding unit.
bigbluebutton.kurento: Kurento Media Server, responsible for streaming webcams, listen-only audio, and screensharing.

jabref.cli: Command-line interface package; ordinary “CLI” means text-based terminal interaction.
jabref.gui: Outer shell API layer that interacts with users and knows their preferences.
jabref.logic: Intermediate layer that manipulates the model and handles reading, writing, import, and export.
jabref.model: Central core holding key data structures and only a small amount of logic.
jabref.preferences: Utility package representing user-customizable settings; ordinary “preferences” means personal choices.
